items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: The transcript mentions 'Miss Gin' only as a nickname for Dinah Washington ('Sing it, Miss Gin'), and the interviewee (Arnett Cobb) narrates an incident involving Dinah and Lionel Hamp. There is no direct interaction or personal relationship described between Arnett Cobb and Dinah Washington in this
